notes.title: Lost Ember studio reveals its next game, and dang, it's got some really good snow
notes.content: You never know what'll catch your eye when you're watching a trailer for a new game: Glitzy graphics, great character design, hot gunplay—or maybe something a little more subtle, as is the case in today's trailer for Ikuma: The Frozen Compass. "Dang, some really good snow in this game," PC Gamer's Tyler Wilde said, a comment that made me curious because really, how good could the snow be? But you know what? Dang, that is some good snow... Read more.

notes.title: Today, we finally revealed our new game – IKUMA – The Frozen Compass!
notes.content:
Hi all!
Have you watched the Triple-I Showcase just now? If you haven’t, you should! It was filled to the brim with amazing indie games and our brand-new reveal trailer was part of it as well! I can tell you; 5 years is a very long time to not talk about what you’re working on :D So we’re very excited to finally be able to show you! 

Here’s the reveal trailer:
[previewyoutube=I7OcvgvPqsc;full][/previewyoutube]

And the full showcase with all games:
[previewyoutube=rnNhA7vLgZ0;full][/previewyoutube]

We also have a behind-the scenes within the post-show segment, which should be going on right now.
We hope you liked the trailer and would love to hear some feedback <3
Oh, and also, don’t forget to wishlist and follow so you don’t miss when something exciting happens over here 😉

Hugs and Kisses,
Your Moonies
